datasets.source: Curated public academic metadata for EUV optics, multilayers, masks, High-NA imaging, resist and stochastic learning topics
datasets.license: OpenEUV original summaries and metadata compilation are repository-licensed; linked papers and publisher records retain their own copyright and access terms
datasets.provenance: Stores DOI/title/year/authors/publication type/topic links and original OpenEUV summaries only; no full paper text is copied, and preprint/conference records are explicitly labeled rather than treated as production-system proof
Contains no measured n/k data; contributors must populate only from lawfully redistributable public sources
